items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He sent for me and asked if I wanted to work there on 14th Street with him.

ctx.x: Well after that, that's when I met him -- when I met him, that's why he was playing in the dancing schools, you know. He sent for me and asked if I wanted to work there on 14th Street with him. I said sure. And it was good, because I was a stranger in New York and I was trying to find my way around, you know. I'd take some gigs here and gigs there with different musicians. And when I met June Clark, this was like a learning school. Things you go to school and learn, you know, you put it work. You know, see how…
